description: Free: read a public PayScout (formerly Spot-Check) receipt. Give id (sc-... from endpoint_spot_check's receipt_id, or a 10-hex crawl id) or url (latest live + crawl receipt for that URL). Receipts hold the listing URL, the live 402 terms, verdict, reason, timestamp. Does not run a fresh check (use endpoint_spot_check for that).
name: get_receipt
